narrative:
Operating expenses are USD 31.4B in the FY2026 budget, planned by cost center and legal entity: Operations & Maintenance about 38%, G&A — Corporate 22%, Exploration 18%, Trading & Risk Management 12% and Regulatory & Carbon Compliance 10%.

Headcount lines are driven from the workforce plan; non-headcount lines use drivers — workover jobs, facility operating hours, seismic programs, open positions and tonnes of CO2. Shared corporate costs are allocated to assets by production.

Carbon compliance is the fastest-growing line: CCS operations and offsets cost about USD 2.8B at USD 40/t, and each +USD 10/t adds USD 0.7B.

signals.title: Brent sensitivity: $2.1B revenue per $1/bbl
signals.source: Meridian Corporate Planning — price deck model
signals.excerpt: Every $1/bbl Brent move changes FY2026 revenue by about $2.1B and net income by about $0.9B after the price-linked royalty tier and 46% effective tax.

signals.title: Trading-book hedge program
signals.excerpt: Hedge notional $58B, 96% effective under IFRS 9; cash-flow hedge reserve $1.65B; ineffectiveness −$85M from Singapore–Rotterdam crack basis.
